comparisons.peer_summary: Time deposits included $44.86 billion as of December 2024 and $29.46 billion as of December 2023 accounted for at fair value under the fair value option.

GS provides similar specificity for liabilities, disclosing that time deposits included $44.86 billion as of December 2024 were accounted for at fair value under the fair value option.

comparisons.peer_topic: Fair value option election for lending-related commitments
comparisons.peer_summary: As of December 31, 2024 and 2023, the contractual amount of lending-related commitments for which the fair value option was elected was $12.2 billion and $9.7 billion, respectively, with corresponding fair values of $50 million and $97 million.
comparisons.comparison: Both BAC and JPMorgan Chase (JPM) utilize the fair value option for lending-related instruments, though BAC reports on outstanding loan balances while JPM reports on lending-related commitments. BAC lists consumer and commercial loans under the fair value option, whereas JPM discloses that the contractual amount of lending-related commitments for which the fair value option was elected was $12.2 billion as of December 31, 2024.

sentences.text: (3)Consumer loans accounted for under the fair value option includes residential mortgage loans of $59 million and home equity loans of $162 million.

At December 31, 2024 and 2023, the contractual amount of lending-related commitments for which the fair value option was elected was $12.2 billion and $9.7 billion, respectively, with a corresponding fair value of $50 million and $97 million, respectively.

comparisons.peer_topic: Accounting treatment of loans at fair value
comparisons.peer_summary: Loans for which the fair value option is elected are carried at fair value within Trading assets, with changes recognized in earnings. This accounting treatment excludes these loans from the allowance for credit losses and charge-off policies.
comparisons.comparison: BAC and Morgan Stanley (MS) both disclose the accounting treatment for loans where the fair value option is elected, noting that these instruments are reported at fair value. BAC's footnote details the composition of these loans, while MS explicitly states that such loans are included in Trading assets and that changes in fair value are recognized in earnings, excluding them from allowance for credit losses policies.

sentences.text: Commercial loans accounted for under the fair value option includes U.S. commercial loans of $2.8 billion and non-U.S. commercial loans of $1.3 billion.
Loans for which the fair value option is elected are carried at fair value and included in Trading assets in the balance sheet, with changes in fair value recognized in earnings.
Because such loans and lending commitments are reported at fair value, the allowance for credit losses and charge-off policies do not apply to these loans.
